detect_seasonality_acf: detect seasonality in a univariate time series using the ACFDetector autocorrelation function method
detect_seasonality_fft: detect seasonality in a univariate time series using the FFTDetector Fast Fourier Transform method
remove_seasonality_decompose: remove seasonality from a time series by decomposing it into trend, seasonal, and residual components
plot_acf_detection: plot the autocorrelation function detection results with optional decomposition visualization using matplotlib
plot_fft_detection: plot the FFT detection results as a plotly figure showing peaks and outlier boundary
